description: Independent post-v1 X21 complete-q121 architecture-capacity experiment at k={20,24}, D={8,14}, with a uniform plateau stopping rule, complex64 training, zero-update complex128 development replay, and a deterministic D16 promotion decision.

forbidden_inputs.policy: Historical blind and capacity-holdout material is unavailable to every development command, gate, result extractor, and D16 adjudication input.

environment.note: This is an independent post-v1 environment and must not be described as the frozen v1 PyTorch 2.5.1 environment.

scientific_policy.geometry: X21 type-(2,1) P5 x P1 seed 20260802
scientific_policy.physical_dictionary: fixed complete q=121 canonical matrix-unit dictionary
scientific_policy.coefficient_gauge: mixed-canonical with center floor(k/2), fixed before epoch zero
scientific_policy.parameter_scope: all coefficient cores jointly trained; q=121 dictionary, reference H, and positive floor fixed

estimand.name: uniform-validation-plateau-stopping-rule endpoint contrast
estimand.definition: Every cell uses the same primary and precision plateau rules and is evaluated after its own rule-triggered training exposure.
estimand.exposure_record: The terminal D16 decision records and hashes actual rounds, epochs, optimizer updates, validation evaluations, and trainer runtime for both stages of every seed.

scientific_policy.training_precision: complex64 for every optimization and validation-based checkpoint decision
scientific_policy.development_evaluation: each selected complex64 endpoint is promoted exactly to complex128 without optimizer updates and evaluated on the immutable development-confirmation pool
scientific_policy.selection_role: development only; this pool has already informed historical model selection
scientific_policy.blind_policy: no historical blind pool is read; any new blind evaluation requires a separately frozen candidate manifest

d16_promotion.status: preregistered deterministic decision job; D16 accuracy remains extension-only
d16_promotion.required_validity: all twelve complex128 replay rows have minimum metric eigenvalue > 0 and nonpositive metric count = 0
d16_promotion.paired_sigma_win_definition: strict per-seed inequality sigma(k24,D14)<sigma(k24,D8); a tie is not a win
d16_promotion.mean_ratio_definition: For sigma, chi, q999, and CVaR, divide the arithmetic mean over the three k24,D14 seeds by the arithmetic mean over the same three paired k24,D8 seeds.
d16_promotion.missing_evidence_policy: Any missing, duplicate, malformed, non-finite, wrong-seed, wrong-grid, or hash-inconsistent evidence fails the decision job without creating an artifact.
d16_promotion.extension_rule: D16 may run only under a new manifest and RUN_ROOT after the complete base aggregate and promotion decision JSON are hash-frozen; the extension must first pass the same full-batch memory gates.

scientific.role: zero-update precision-roundtrip calibration; not a metric result
full-pool one-epoch maximum-cell forward/backward/Adam/validation/checkpoint preflight; never used as a scientific initialization or result
scientific.batch_fallback: forbidden; an OOM requires a new registered optimizer-path manifest

scientific.role: create-only deterministic D16 promotion adjudication; false is a valid terminal decision

scientific.initialization: complex64 common-k4 learned norm repeated exactly with fixed one-sided bridge activation
scientific.paired_seed_role: site activation depends only on replicate and is shared across D
bond activation and optimizer seeds depend only on replicate

scientific.role: complex64 epoch-zero learned-function and metric equivalence gate
hash-bound zero-update exact binary promotion for development evaluation
